div.head: VIII Atr 15
div.ab: And gif hwa þæt nelle, gewilde man hine to rihte mid worldlicre steore, ⁊ þæt si gemæne Criste ⁊ cyninge, ealswa hit iu wæs.
And gif hwa þæt nelle, gewilde man hine to rihte mid worldlicre steore; and þæt si gemæne Criste and cyninge, ealswa hit iu wæs.
And if anyone refuses to do so, he shall be brought to justice by a civil penalty, and this shall be divided between Christ and the king, in accordance with former custom.
And if anyone will not do so, he is to be brought to justice by means of a civil penalty; and this shall be shared between Christ and the king, just as it was of old.
Und wenn einer dies weigert, zwinge man ihn zur Rechtserfüllung durch bürgerliche Strafe: und dies [Strafgeld] gehöre der Kirche und dem König gemeinsam, wie es früher gewesen ist.
And if anyone refuses this, let him be compelled to do right by secular punishment: and let this [fine] belong to Christ and the king jointly, as it was before.
